Name: Woodlore Expanded
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][img width=824]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788192013-957466547.png[/img][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]
[b]An expansion mod that adds new trees, resources, crafting and artisan goods, NPCs, locations, farm buildings, recipes, quests, and mechanics centered around woodworking and the forest.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][b][b]Chop trees for more than just wood, process lumber into useful materials, and discover new wild trees. Along the way, meet two new woodland residents, explore new areas, complete freight contracts, and keep a field journal documenting what you find.[/b][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][img width=705]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788192030-602327854.png[/img][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][color=#38761d] [b][size=4]Meet the NPCs![/size][/b][/color][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=4][b]- Boue the Beaver - [/b]Sells Furnitures & Tree-flavored Ice Creams[/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=4][b]- Musk the Hedgehog - [/b]Sells Scented Candles[/size][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]
[img width=694]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193194-1957311380.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman]- Trees now produce Softwood Logs or Hardwood Logs alongside vanilla wood when chopped.
- Wood Boards are required for constructing Farm Buildings.
- On small chances, messages about nature might pop up when cutting trees outside of your farm.
- Add 5 Sawdust to Mushroom Logs for a chance to grow higher-quality mushrooms on the next harvest.
- Bark Beetles can be shaken from trees during Summer.
- Craft Paper by putting 2 Wood Pulps in a Recycling Machine.
- Papers can also be traded for books in the Bookseller's shop.[/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=681]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193209-2017279480.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b]Woodlore Expanded adds 4 new wild trees:[/b]
- Walnut
- Douglas Fir
- Black Spruce
- Cypress[/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=676]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788194132-613437899.png[/img][/font][/center]
[quote][center][font=Times New Roman][b][size=4]Basic Resources[/size][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]- Softwood Logs
- Hardwood Logs
- Sawdust
- Wood Pulp[/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]
[b][size=4]Crafting[/size][/b]
- Saw Mill
- Wood Kiln
- Chandlery
- Animal Bedding[/font][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]
[b][size=4]Artisan Goods[/size][/b]
- Softwood Boards
- Hardwood Boards
- Dried Softwood Boards
- Dried Hardwood Boards
- Walnut Oil
- Black Spruce Resin
- Douglas Fir Pitch
- Cypress Resin
- Pine Scented Candle
- Douglas Fir Scented Candle
- Black Spruce Scented Candle
- Cypress Scented Candle[/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman](! Candles can be placed anywhere, walking near it's vicinity and smelling the scent will give you buffs)[/font][/center]
[/quote][center][font=Times New Roman][img width=597]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193333-1059506604.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b]The Lumber Mill farm building includes:[/b]
- Built-in Deluxe Wood Kiln
- Built-in Deluxe Saw Mill
- 5 Chests
- 1 Work Bench[/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=599]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193352-1557373324.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b][size=4]Crafting[/size][/b]
- Garden Mulch
- Paper
- Sky Lantern
- Pine Salve
- Douglas Fir Salve
- Black Spruce Salve
[b][size=4]Cooking[/size][/b]
- Mapress Ice Cream
- FirNut Ice Cream
- OakPine Ice Cream
- Sprine Ice Cream[/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=562]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193387-571762920.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b]- Hollow Bank - [/b]A Riverbank located at the Northeastern corner of Town
[b]- Woodland Lookout -[/b] Visit the lookout tower to observe the forest and record discoveries in their field journal, located at the Northeastern part of Hollow Bank.
[b]- Hearthwood Forest - [/b]A forest located at the Southern end corner of Hollow Bank.
[b]- Freight Train - [/b]Only available on Wednesdays and Saturdays. Can be found in the Railroad region.[/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=554]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193419-2134442263.png[/img][/font]

[quote][b][font=Times New Roman]The journal contains 5 chapters, each featuring its own quest, storyline, and rewards. Progress through the chapters to uncover more of what the forest has to offer.
- Can only be accessed after completing a quest once the tower is built. [/font][/b][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=513]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193430-510668772.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=282]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788194207-1211804502.png[/img]
[b]Accept freight contracts to deliver boards, logs, or paper. Complete your deliveries to earn money and other random rewards.[/b][/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=521]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193671-176762076.png[/img][/font]

[quote][b][font=Times New Roman]- This mod has no compatibility issues with SVE as far as I know. However if you happen to encounter any, feel free to let me know by posting them in the bugs section so I can take a look.
- Not currently compatible with Seven Deadly Sins or other mods altering the northeastern part of town.[/font][/b][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=530]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193681-1051834488.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b]1. Download and extract the mod files.[/b]
[b]2. Move the extracted files to your Mods folder.[/b]
[b]3. Launch the game.
(Optional) 4. If you're on an existing save please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44842]Reset Terrain Feature.[/url][/b][/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman][img width=572]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51525/51525-1788193695-1599253323.png[/img][/font]

[quote][font=Times New Roman][b]- I'm posting this now because uni is starting to get busy again. With that, I apologize in advance if I won't be able to respond quickly :]
- You're free to create portrait or visual mods only if you ask permission first, but if you'll use generative AI, don't even bother.[/b]
[b]- If you enjoy my work and want to see more in the future, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/latteholn]buying me a coffee[/url]! I’m a student with limited free time, so any support helps me keep working on projects like this :3[/b][/font][/quote][/center]
